text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and C after large gains felt rewarding, but I should sell only when it fits my plan—not just to lock in a profit.","Buying more shares in all five stocks at once increased my exposure; I should size purchases deliberately and preserve diversification and cash flexibility.","My account value fluctuated despite periods of gains, and past price moves do not predict what comes next; I should make decisions using a consistent risk-based plan."]}
